messages:
lee: Heads up — we're getting a burst of GPU spot/preemptible evictions in us-west1-c, started ~06:15 UTC. Seeing ~15 nodes reclaimed in last 8m, cluster GPU capacity down ~18%. :rotating_light:
infra-bot: alert: gpu-eviction-surge us-west1-c (count=15, window=10m)
sam: p95 inference latency spiked to 2.4s around 06:17, error rate up 1.8%. Dashboards -> https://dash.redwood.internal/infra/cluster-gpu
maria: autoscaler log shows a lot of immediate nodeTerminated events and scale-up churn. Some pods are Pending with "Insufficient GPU".
alex: Confirmed on GCP console: preemptible pool in us-west1-c got reclaimed after a maintenance window. Preemptible count dropped from 60 -> 30.
ops-oncall: I'm going to cordon the remaining preemptible GPU nodes so we don't start new work there. Running `kubectl cordon gpupool-preemptible-usw1-0*` now.
jordan: Trying to trigger fallback: routing policy should send new requests to dedicated pool (tag: redwood-dedicated-gpu). I'll bump weight to 80% dedicated, 20% best-effort.
maria: Small mitigation: reduce default batch_size from 8 -> 4 for model routes in us-west; that'll slightly increase token cost but helps latency during reduced capacity. Pushing config now.
lee: ops-oncall, can you drain the most fragmented nodes and move long-running jobs to dedicated? Use `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` on the worst ones.
ops-oncall: Draining gpupool-preemptible-usw1-03, 04. Note: some pods have local KV caches; I'm adding eviction-annotation to preserve prefix caches later.
sam: After routing & batch change, p95 back to 1.1s, error rate dropping. Still seeing flapping in one AZ though.
alex: Filing GCP incident with quota team — looks like preemptible reclaim threshold triggered by a regional maintenance. Requesting estimate for replacement preemptible pool.
jordan: Also enabled allowedFallbackModels so non-critical routes can use smaller quantized variants to reduce GPU footprint.
maria: Followups: 1) autoscaler tolerances need smoothing to avoid scale-churn during reclaim events 2) maintain baseline on-demand/dedicated capacity >= 20% for GPU pools 3) add preemptible eviction handler to evict gracefully earlier. Creating tickets.
lee: Good triage. For postmortem: include timeline, cost delta from fallback to dedicated, and whether we should change preemptible percentage in us-west. Assign to @maria and @alex.
ops-oncall: All preemptible nodes drained; traffic shifted. We'll keep watch for 30m. If GCP can't replenish, plan is to spin up two more dedicated nodes.
infra-bot: incident-note: mitigation_applied (routing-weight-change, batch-size-reduction, node-drain).
lee: Thanks all. If you see any more flapping tag me or page.
thread_summary: Partial outage / latency spike caused by preemptible GPU evictions in us-west1-c. Team cordoned/drained preemptible nodes, shifted traffic to dedicated pool, reduced batch sizes, and opened follow-up tickets to harden autoscaler and baseline on-demand capacity.
